research_question: Can the already-owned 2010-2015 Databento Henry Hub history extend the exact frozen M1-M2 one-session spread-change development sample without changing source, roll, target, or protected-window rules?
search_scope: Primary venue/vendor technical documentation plus government evidence on the 2010-2015 natural-gas regime, interpreted before protected outcomes and without treating alternative data semantics as interchangeable.

sources.title: Natural gas production and prices in 2015

claim_map.claim: The frozen source semantics require venue daily settlement statistics distinguished from preliminary/intraday values, plus cleared volume for the roll rule.
The 2010-2015 period spans material US natural-gas production and price regime change, so extra history cannot be assumed scientifically interchangeable merely because it is older.

expected_observations: If pre-2015 history is admissible under unchanged rules, outright NG sessions should contain final daily settlement and observed cleared volume together often enough to construct the same M1/M2 target.
The first usable 2015 date should be explainable by source/normalization lineage rather than unexplained feature loss.
disconfirming_observations: Pre-2015 outright NG records lack the final-settlement plus cleared-volume combination required by the frozen roll and target semantics.
Admission requires substituting OHLCV, preliminary settlement, another roll rule, or other post-result changes.
